design.name: 雷鼓夔
design.brief: The Kui (夔) of the Shan Hai Jing, a one-legged ox-like beast whose hide made the thunder drum heard for five hundred li: a stout grey-blue ox beast with a huge round belly that is stretched like a drum skin with painted thunder spirals, ONE single thick leg in the middle of its body ending in a big hoof, short stubby forelimbs, small horns, frost on its back. It hops on its one leg and beats its own belly to launch hail; the drum belly glows pale jade-green when charged (weak spot). Gruff and booming.
design.weapon: both stubby forelimbs drumming on its glowing belly, hailstones bursting out
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert roster (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges, ice as a few big faceted shapes, paper and cloth as thick simple bands, fur as big carved clumps.
